verdict.rationale: Galileo's release notes describe organizing sessions, traces and spans into queues for structured review by subject matter experts, which matches routing outputs to annotation queues. The marketing site also says it captures SME annotations into datasets, which covers the labeling side. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on queue configuration and routing rules (manual vs. automatic or SDK-driven), annotation/label schema details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
